title: Phillip O NDE 21396
content: I fell down an empty stairwell backwards. I landed over the lower corner of floor, did a flip, and hit my head on a brick. I was unconscious, but don't know how long. When I knew nothing was under foot, I jumped out of my body, stayed on top, and watched the body at the bottom of stairwell. Then I went down and watched laborers and carpenters run up to me and stand around talking about me. A bricklayer pushed me on the shoulder, and I jumped back in my body. I was lying face down facing away, and could have not seen this with my eyes. I am still half out of body, and people sense this, although they do not know what it is, and they fear it!

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' don't know? I still have my out of body experience. All day, every day.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Unconscious, then semiconscious for three months, and then to about seventy percent now, but with an out of body experience.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning There was no sense of time.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I used my senses of knowing.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I have a sense of knowing, and no fear of what might be.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes People feel it when they are within the part of me that is outside of my body.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Some were influenced by the experience, and some weren't.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: Not at this time. Thank you!
